title: matchup-scheme-2026-09-13
universal_lens: A probabilistic framework for evaluating offensive line stability and quarterback protection efficiency using pressure rate and clean pocket metrics. Matchup dynamics and coaching aggression map to possession-based TD generation via 4th-down frequency and home-field advantage.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models the likelihood of sustained offensive drive success based on PFF pressure metrics and O-line composition changes. Bayesian belief updates on team identity reverting to baseline using historical Week 1 scoring trends and 4th-down aggression metrics.
gse_mapping: State-transition dynamics model how new personnel decisions (e.g., Sewell to LT, Ragnow retired) alter the probability distribution of pass protection outcomes. Situational state transitions driven by defensive line pressure, QB dropback volume, and coaching decisions affecting play-calling and scoring probability.
